race.comment: THE TROUBLESHOOTER (6) has been tackling stronger races of late, third in a strong race at Flemington first up before an even effort there last time. Back in grade now and rates highly, go close. NAFSIKA (10) is a nicely bred three-year-old filly on debut by Toronado for the Clinton McDonald yard. She's jumped out well and the stable warrant respect. HOPEFUL CHAMPION (9) is a first-starter for the Jerome Hunter yard by Banquo from Wannabe who has been a prolific producer including winners at black type level. Respecting off a jumpout win. SEATICFLASH (5) is a mare by Hanseatic out of The Grey Flash making her first appearance for the Begg yard who are always dangerous. Keep safe. Chances don't end there.
